categories.main_business_segments: Chien Shing International Co., Ltd. operates primarily in integrated logistics services including customs brokerage, warehousing, transportation, bulk cargo ship loading/unloading, inland container depot operations, and air cargo consolidation. The company provides a one-stop logistics solution integrating import/export customs clearance, warehousing, transportation, bulk cargo terminal operations, and container depot services. Major business segments by revenue proportion are ship loading/unloading (59%), warehousing (23%), transportation (9%), and customs brokerage (9%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automation and mechanization technologies in bulk cargo handling, such as automated coal unloading and enclosed coal storage facilities to improve efficiency and environmental protection. It uses computerized management systems including ERP and CS Cloud 2.0 platform for operational integration and customer service enhancement. The logistics operations emphasize computerized workflow, electronic data interchange (EDI), and IT integration for customs clearance and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include import/export manufacturers, shipping companies, cargo owners, and freight forwarders primarily in Taiwan's industrial and trade sectors. The company serves clients in major Taiwanese ports including Keelung, Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung, with a focus on supporting Taiwan's import/export trade activities. It also targets customers involved in bulk commodities like coal, scrap iron, copper ore, and wind power equipment, as well as high-tech manufacturers in science parks.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with service coverage across major port regions including Keelung, Taipei, Taichung, Kaohsiung, and Anping ports. The company also operates logistics centers in the Central Taiwan Science Park and Taichung Port Free Trade Zone. It has subsidiaries managing operations in Taichung and Kaohsiung ports and is expanding services to Taipei Port.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chien Shing International operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the logistics supply chain, providing integrated logistics services such as customs clearance, warehousing, transportation, and cargo handling. It acts as a service provider facilitating the movement and storage of goods rather than manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing integrated one-stop logistics services, expanding container depot operations, and promoting digital transformation through ERP and cloud platforms for improved customer engagement. It prioritizes environmental sustainability by investing in automated and enclosed cargo handling equipment to reduce pollution. The company emphasizes occupational safety, lean management, and talent development, while continuously upgrading IT systems for operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from customs brokerage, warehousing rental, transportation services, bulk cargo loading/unloading, and container depot operations. The company also earns income from leasing land and facilities at port industrial zones. Its subsidiaries contribute to consolidated revenue through similar logistics and cargo handling services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading integrated logistics service provider in Taiwan, especially dominant in bulk cargo handling at Taichung Port with a market share exceeding 40%. It competes with a limited number of operators in bulk cargo handling and faces intense competition in customs brokerage and transportation sectors. Its one-stop integrated service model and advanced automation provide competitive advantages over peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2024, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$2.9 billion, a 24.8% increase from the prior year, with net income rising 27.2% to about NT$435 million. The company has shown steady growth in assets and equity, with total assets exceeding NT$16.8 billion and equity around NT$4.57 billion. Operating profit margins and return on equity have improved, reflecting enhanced profitability and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chien Shing International differentiates itself by offering a comprehensive one-stop logistics solution integrating customs clearance, warehousing, transportation, and cargo handling, unmatched by competitors. Its investment in automated and environmentally friendly cargo handling equipment enhances operational efficiency and sustainability. The company’s extensive warehousing capacity in strategic port locations and advanced IT systems for customer service and operational management further strengthen its value proposition.
